The '''Claer system''' was located in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained the astronomical object [[Clær]], which was the site of an exclusive [[Clær preparatory academy|preparatory academy]]<ref name="CRO" /> at some point between [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'' states that [[Rivoche Tarkin]] was sent by her uncle [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff]] to attend the [[Clær preparatory academy|preparatory academy]] on [[Clær]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Rivoche's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Gideon Tarkin]]. {{CSWECite|III|220|Tarkin, Gideon}} establishes that Gideon died five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As ''The New Essential Chronology'' also establishes that Wilhuff Tarkin perished in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Rivoche's enrollment at the Clær academy must have taken place sometime between those two dates.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Claer system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
